company.footprint_line: Hospitals & physician clinics — South Carolina · FY2024 Form 990

why_now.summary: McLeod Health's FY2024 Form 990 reports $340.8M in revenue with more than $43M of indirect, third-party spend across insurance, technology, supplies, and outside services — the recurring categories where health-system costs tend to drift while attention stays on clinical priorities.
signals: $43.5M of addressable indirect spend is visible in the FY2024 filing — roughly 13% of revenue
The spend concentrates in categories where ERA's healthcare engagements most consistently find recovery: insurance, supplies, and outside services
Sector-wide, hospital cost inflation continues to outpace reimbursement growth, putting every non-clinical dollar under closer scrutiny

headline: The Opportunity Inside the Operating Budget.

categories.label: Insurance
categories.rationale: Premiums reported at $6.4M in the FY2024 filing. Carrier and broker terms are among the categories ERA re-prices most consistently across healthcare engagements.

categories.label: IT Hardware/Services
categories.rationale: The filing reports $25.4M in information technology — a scale of licenses, support, and connectivity contracts that a baseline reviews line by line.

categories.label: Office Supplies
categories.rationale: Office expenses of $5.0M in the filing — high-volume, frequently re-bid spend where consolidated pricing routinely moves.

categories.label: Professional Services
categories.rationale: Legal, accounting, and consulting fees totaling $4.8M in the filing — rate cards and scopes that benchmark cleanly across the sector.

categories.label: Marketing Services
categories.rationale: Advertising and promotion of $1.4M in the filing — agency and media terms with wide market spreads.
